title: Appointment Escort Coordination Gap
dataSources: Pendant alerts (`care:pendant`), medication adherence (`care:medication`), wandering alerts (`care:geofence`), check-ins (`care:checkin`), care-plan follow-up (`care:ops`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — PERS pendant alerts, medication blister-pack reminders, and wandering geofence signals — streamed to Splunk HEC via caregiver apps, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=care:ops appointment_type=* escort_state=*
| stats sum(eval(if(escort_state!="assigned",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by appointment_type
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending escort assignments backlog by appointment type for appointment coordination.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside appointment coordination.
implementation: Mark each `care:ops` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `appointment_type`.
visualization: Table of appointment type with pending escort assignments counts.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates where unfinished escort assignments are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in appointment coordination.
